invariants.description: vesicle-site occupancy is conserved: V_Ca + V_1Ca + ... + V_5Ca stays at its initial total (all rate terms of the 5-site binding scheme cancel in the sum)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((V_Ca + V_1Ca + V_2Ca + V_3Ca + V_4Ca + V_5Ca) - (V_Ca + V_1Ca + V_2Ca + V_3Ca + V_4Ca + V_5Ca)[0])) <= 1e-9

invariants.description: Cai is exactly Cai(t) = -i_Ca/(2 F V_Z 1e-6 K_Ca) (1 - exp(-K_Ca t)) from 0 for constant i_Ca

bc_sweep.rationale: N-type Ca current of a varicosity during an action potential is of the order of 0.1 nA or less.
